name: Nefer
notes: A Dendro Lunar-Bloom main DPS. Her Skill, Senet Strategy, and her Burst both deal ATK plus twice her EM, and her Lunar-Bloom reaction scales with her EM, so EM is the scaling stat and the Skill carries the damage (both sources: Skill, then Burst, then Normal Attack). Both sources agree on 4pc Night of the Sky's Unveiling as best by a wide margin (KQM gives Gilded Dreams as a weaker stand-in), EM Sands and Goblet, a CRIT Circlet and Reliquary of Truth first, with Nightweaver's Looking Glass, Tome of the Eternal Flow, Dawning Frost and Blackmarrow Lantern on both lists. KQM's Circlet is 'CRIT > EM', Game8's CRIT DMG or CRIT Rate; EM stays as the last choice. Goals are Game8's: EM 500 or above, CRIT Rate 40-50% before the set's CRIT Rate bonus (upper end 50), CRIT DMG 220% or above. ER is KQM's 105% for solo Dendro (100% in double or triple Dendro); Game8 gives none. Partners are a judgment from the Lunar-Bloom reaction.
